metadata.title: Mpinger Engineering — Precision CNC Manufacturing
metadata.description: ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of high-precision 5-axis CNC-milled and turned components. German coordination from Hannover, precision manufacturing in Coimbatore.
metadata.contactDescription: Send Mpinger Engineering your drawings, specifications or manufacturing enquiry.

hero.h1: Mpinger Engineering — precision 5-axis CNC milled and turned components, ISO 9001:2015 certified, engineered in Hannover and manufactured in Coimbatore.
hero.title: Precision CNC Manufacturing
hero.beat1Text: Every setup is simulated and collision-checked before a tool touches metal — so the first part and the thousandth come off identical.
hero.beat2Text: 5-axis milling and mill-turn finish complex geometry in a single clamping — fewer setups, truer position, shorter lead times.
hero.beat3Text: Aerospace alloys, hardened steels and exotics — machined to tolerance across the full production run, not just the sample.
hero.beat4Text: 100% verified on calibrated CMMs, with documentation your quality team can audit. ISO 9001:2015 certified.
hero.imgAlt: 5-axis CNC machining sequence — simulation through finished component

about.title: Precision is our profession
about.description: Mpinger Engineering India Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of high-precision CNC-milled and turned components — built for parts that demand precise detail and tight tolerances.
about.pillar1Text: Coordinated from Hannover, machined in Coimbatore — one central contact, one standard of quality.
about.pillar2Text: Qualified partners for casting, die casting, sheet metal and surface treatment extend our machining core.
about.pillar3Text: Quality-assured components with punctual delivery — at production costs up to 70% below European levels.
about.caption: From drawing to dispatch — one digital thread
about.imgAlt: From CAD program to machined component — the Mpinger digital thread

parts.title: Parts
parts.industrialText: Impeller hubs, gear cases, turbocharger housings and heavy-engine components — 5-axis milled and turned in a single setup, held to 0.001 mm discipline.
parts.aerospaceText: Flight-critical geometries in demanding alloys — machined, measured on calibrated CMMs and validated before a single part leaves the floor.
parts.closing: 8 component families · ISO 9001:2015 · validated before dispatch

machines.title: Machines & infrastructure
machines.description: A high-technology park of 5-axis milling, mill-turn and turn-mill centers from DMG MORI, MAZAK, Hüller Hille, IBARMIA and Chiron — inside an 11,000 ft² dust-controlled shopfloor. Keep scrolling to move through the park.

quality.title: Quality
quality.beatText: Every component is verified on calibrated coordinate-measuring infrastructure inside a temperature-managed quality room — 100% documented before dispatch.
quality.metrologyText: Hexagon Global CMM, FARO Arm Prime and Zoller presetting — backed by a full ledger of calibrated Mitutoyo instruments.
quality.closing: Hexagon · FARO · Zoller · Mahr · Haimer — 100% documented
quality.imgAlt: Metrology lab — calibrated CMM inspection of machined components
